Jury service and disability

55. Disabled people are called for jury service on the same basis as non-disabled people. By
s.9B Juries Act 1974, it is for the judge to determine whether or not a person should act as
a juror. The presumption is that they should so act unless the judge is of the opinion that the
person will not, on account of disability, be capable of acting effectively as a juror, in which
case that person should be discharged.
